# Detroit Lions

> > Official website of the Detroit Lions NFL team, featuring ticketing, premium seating at Ford Field, international fan engagement in Brazil, youth football education programs, and team information.

The Detroit Lions official site serves fans with comprehensive ticketing options including Lions Loyal Members season tickets, premium suites and hospitality packages, and group sales. The site also features youth football education programs through USA Football partnerships, international market expansion in Brazil with Portuguese content, and mascot Roary's community engagement activities.

## Key Topics

- Detroit Lions
- Ford Field
- Lions Loyal Members
- Premium Seating & Suites
- Season Tickets
- Dan Campbell
- Jared Goff
- Ticketmaster

- USA Football
- Brazil International Market
- Roary Mascot
- Training Camp
- Guest Services
- Group Tickets

## Ticketing & Season Tickets

- [Lions Loyal Members](https://www.detroitlions.com/tickets/season-tickets/lions-loyal-members): Lions Loyal Members season ticket benefits and perks program
- [Group Tickets](https://www.detroitlions.com/tickets/groups/group-tickets): Group ticket sales with contacts for Adam Felix and Seth Henderson
- [Ticketing FAQs](https://www.detroitlions.com/about-us/faqs-tickets): Ticketing FAQs covering admission policies and Ford Field entrance info
- [Training Camp Ticket FAQs](https://www.detroitlions.com/training-camp/ticket-faqs): 2025 Training Camp ticket FAQs for free admission via Ticketmaster

## Premium Seating & Hospitality

- [Suites and Hospitality](https://www.detroitlions.com/tickets/premium-seating/suite-and-hospitality-tracking): Premium seating options including suites and VIP hospitality at Ford Field
- [Premium Partnerships Representatives](https://www.detroitlions.com/tickets/premium-seating/premium-partnerships-representatives): Premium seating sales team contacts including Lindsay Frattaroli

## International Fan Engagement

- [Brazil Hub](https://www.detroitlions.com/international/brazil): Brazil international market hub with Portuguese content and fan engagement
- [Brazil Events](https://www.detroitlions.com/international/brazil-events): Brazil fan events including São Paulo Thanksgiving watch parties
- [Learn About the Team - Brazil](https://www.detroitlions.com/international/learn-about-the-team-brazil): Team roster for Brazil market featuring Terrion Arnold and Derrick Barnes

## Youth Football Education

- [Fundamentals Camps](https://www.detroitlions.com/football-education/fundamentals-camps): Youth football fundamentals camps with USA Football training programs
- [Virtual Summer Camp - Offensive Line](https://www.detroitlions.com/football-education/virtual-summer-camp/offensive-line): Virtual summer camp training videos for offensive line techniques

## Fan Experience & Mascot

- [Roary the Mascot](https://www.detroitlions.com/roary): Roary mascot info, community appearances, and Cub Club membership
- [Guest Services FAQs](https://www.detroitlions.com/about-us/faqs-guest-services): Ford Field guest services FAQs for stadium amenities and cashless venue

## Optional

- [2018 Preseason: Giants at Lions](https://www.detroitlions.com/game-day/2018/pre/giants-at-lions): 2018 preseason Week 2 game recap: Giants at Lions at Ford Field
